name: Text
doc: Text from the `text` param or the track's lyrics (.lrc next to the track), in a baked font: the code-drawn pixel font (bitmap, pixel-perfect) or an MSDF display font (sharp at any size). Modes: centred, kinetic (letters jump on onsets), typewriter (types each lyric line out over its duration), marquee and sine scroller. Coloured along the palette.

text.doc: shown when source is text, or when there are no lyrics right now

wrap.doc: line width before wrapping, in screen widths (centre, kinetic, typewriter)

kick.doc: how far letters jump on onsets

speed.doc: marquee / scroller: screen widths per second

assets.source: Orbitron, The Orbitron Project Authors (renamed: Reserved Font Name)
